resources.content:
#Intensive 2.0 - Further Steps Exciting news! You have completed a major milestone in our program. Remember, your dedication and hard work have brought you this far, and the journey ahead holds immense potential. We're here to support you every step of the way, ensuring you have the tools and resources to achieve your career goals. Here's what's in store for you: - Course Exams - Placement Preparation - Job Portal - Industry Ready Certification(IRC)
**Course Exams** - The course exam aims to assess your understanding and knowledge of the course content and serves as a means to evaluate your readiness and proficiency in the subject. - Before you proceed, make sure to complete your course exams.
**Course Exams Schedule - MERN Full Stack** |Day | 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM | 2:00 PM - 3:00 PM | 6:00 PM - 8:00 PM| |--- | --- | --- | ---| |Monday | | | Build Your Own Static Website| |Tuesday | | | Build Your Own Responsive Website| |Wednesday | | |React JS - Getting started| |Thurday | | | Node JS| |Friday | | | Build Your Own Dynamic Web Application| |Saturday | | JavaScript Essentials | Introduction to Databases| |Sunday | Responsive Web Design using Flexbox | Developer Foundations | Programming Foundations|
**Course Exams Schedule - Java Full Stack** |Day | 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM | 2:00 PM - 3:00 PM | 5:00 PM - 8:00 PM|6:00 PM - 8:00 PM| |--- | --- |--- | --- | ---| |Monday | || | Build Your Own Static Website| |Tuesday | || | Build Your Own Responsive Website| |Wednesday | | | |React JS - Getting started| |Thurday | || | Spring Boot| |Friday | | | Java Fundamentals| Build Your Own Dynamic Web Application| |Saturday | | JavaScript Essentials || Introduction to Databases| |Sunday | Responsive Web Design using Flexbox |Developer Foundations || Programming Foundations|
**Course Exams Schedule - QA/Automation Testing** |Day | 2:00 PM - 4:00 PM | 5:00 PM - 8:00 PM | 6:00 PM - 8:00 PM| |--- | --- | --- | ---| |Monday | | | Build Your Own Static Website| |Tuesday | | | Build Your Own Responsive Website| |Wednesday | | | | |Thurday | | | | |Friday | | Java Fundamentals | | |Saturday | | | Introduction to Databases| |Sunday | AutomationTesting with Selenium | | Programming Foundations|
**Course Exams Schedule - Data Analytics** |Day | 3:00 PM - 3:45 PM | 6:00 PM - 8:00 PM| |--- | --- | ---| |Monday | | Build Your Own Static Website| |Tuesday | | Build Your Own Responsive Website| |Wednesday | | | |Thurday | | Data Analytics using Tableau| |Friday | | Analytics using Python| |Saturday | Data Analytics using PowerBI | Introduction to Databases| |Sunday | Data Analytics Foundations | Programming Foundations|
- You can attempt the course exams multiple times to improve your grade. - An overall cumulative grade will be assigned based on your performance across all courses within your chosen job track. The cumulative grade reflects your overall progress and success in the program.
Cumulative Grade = (Sum of all the course Grades present in the Job Track) / (Number of courses present in the job track)
 - It is crucial to maintain good grades throughout the program as it can increase the number of job opportunities available to you. - Recruiters will have access to your grades and performance during the program, and this information may be considered when evaluating candidates for job openings.
**Placement Preparation** - Upon completing all of the courses and attempting each course exam, your placement preparation process starts. - The placement preparation is meticulously crafted to provide you with support, including **resume building, offering interview preparation sessions, and conducting personalized one-on-one mock interviews** to help you hone your interview skills. Since recruiters will have access to your **academic details, personal information**, and **work experience**, it is crucial to ensure they are kept current. Kindly double-check and refresh these particulars in your Profile at https://learning.ccbp.in/edit-profile.
**Job Portal** - After you've polished your skills through mock interviews, you'll be ready to apply for jobs. Leverage your newfound confidence and knowledge to secure the perfect position for your career aspirations. Please note that different companies may have different eligibility requirements for their job openings. If you meet these requirements, you will be able to apply for the company.
**IRC (Industry-Ready Certification)** To be eligible for the Industry-Ready Certification (IRC), you must fulfill the following criteria: - Achieve a cumulative grade of a **minimum of 7.5/10** - Complete all projects with given requirements and pass all plagiarism checks - Complete Project Verification & Viva - Please note that while your grades play a significant role in achieving IRC, they are not the sole determining factor. - Other factors, such as project performance, project verification, and viva, are also considered in evaluating your readiness for the industry.
All the Best!!
